newsitem.title: UK: Croda surges on H1 results, rosy outlook.
newsitem.headline: Croda surges on H1 results, rosy outlook.

text.p: Bucking a sharply lower trend in the broad market, shares in Croda International jumped by almost seven percent, climbing to a three-month high, after the British specialty chemical group said its future looked bright.
By 1203 GMT, the shares were up 21-1/2p to 334-1/2p.

Croda said its chemicals unit, which accounted for 80 percent of turnover, performed well and that "the trading outlook...is healthy." It added that there are clear signs of a nascent recovery and that there is steady economic growth in other parts of the world.
"People are just happy they're admitting a recovery is underway," said one market maker.

The company made its comments in releasing its interim results. It said its pre-tax profits rose to a slightly better-than-expected 22.5 million stg in the first half from 21.5 million stg in the year ago period.
